minigame.MG-09.lane.title: Flight-path angle above the horizon
minigame.MG-09.inset.title: Ascent path
minigame.MG-09.hint.drag: Drag up or down to trace the line
minigame.MG-09.hint.one: Press as each PITCH cue reaches the marker
minigame.MG-09.aria.label: Flight-path angle. Drag up or down, or use the arrow keys, to trace the ideal ascent curve.
minigame.MG-09.aria.label_one: Pitch cues. Press Space or the screen as each pitch cue reaches the marker.
minigame.MG-10a.status.done_ok: STAGE 2 BURNING · BOTH IN THE WINDOW
minigame.MG-10a.line.title: Sequencer
minigame.MG-10a.hint.two: Tap in the green window · keys S and I
minigame.MG-10a.hint.one: One button: first press separates, second ignites
minigame.MG-10a.aria.label: Staging. Press SEPARATE (key S) in the green window just after engine cutoff, then IGNITE (key I) when the propellant has settled.
minigame.MG-10a.aria.label_one: Staging, one button. Press Space or the screen in the green window after engine cutoff to separate, then again when the propellant has settled to ignite.
minigame.MG-10a.aria.burning: Stage 1 burning. Wait for engine cutoff.
minigame.MG-10a.aria.cutoff: Engine cutoff. Separate in the green window.
minigame.MG-07.status.wait: FLIGHT IS POLLING · YOUR CALL IN {s} s
minigame.MG-07.loop.title: FLIGHT loop
minigame.MG-07.reading.hidden: Shown when FLIGHT calls your console
minigame.MG-07.timer.label: Time to answer
minigame.MG-07.hint.two: GO only if every reading is within its limits
minigame.MG-07.hint.one: Press while your answer is lit
minigame.MG-07.aria.label: Go/No-Go poll. When FLIGHT calls your console, press G for GO if every reading is within limits, otherwise N for NO-GO.
minigame.MG-07.aria.label_one: Go/No-Go poll, one button. GO and NO-GO light up in turn; press Space or the screen while your answer is lit.
minigame.MG-07.aria.wait: FLIGHT is polling the other consoles. Your call in {s} seconds.
minigame.MG-08b.status.low: FILLING TOO SLOWLY · OPEN A STEP
minigame.MG-08b.status.high: FILLING TOO FAST · CLOSE A STEP
minigame.MG-08b.tank.title: LOX tank
minigame.MG-08b.gauge.title: Fill rate %/s

minigame.MG-08b.hint.hold: Hold anywhere to fill, let go to close
minigame.MG-08b.hint.toggle: Tap anywhere to open or close the fill valve
minigame.MG-08b.aria.label: Propellant loading. Arrow up opens the fill valve one step, arrow down closes one step. Keep the fill rate in the band and reach 99 percent at T minus 0 without overpressure.
minigame.MG-08b.aria.label_one: Propellant loading, one button. Hold Space or the screen to open the fill valve, release to close it. Reach 99 percent without overpressure.
minigame.MG-11.status.start: FIND THE RHYTHM · TAP ON EACH LOW POINT
minigame.MG-11.status.miss: OFF THE BEAT · WATCH THE RING
minigame.MG-11.wave.title: Lengthwise bounce
minigame.MG-11.hint: Tap anywhere as the ring closes · Space
minigame.MG-11.aria.label: Pogo damper. Press Space or the screen on each low point of the bounce, when the closing ring reaches the centre.
minigame.MG-11.aria.value: {good} of {done} beats in counter-phase. Next low point in {next} seconds.
minigame.MG-12.needle.title: Torque about the centre of mass
minigame.MG-12.scene.title: Engine cluster
minigame.MG-12.list.title: Engines · throttle · gimbal
minigame.MG-12.pad.title: Your engine · throttle {pct} % · gimbal {deg}°
minigame.MG-12.pad.sweeping: sweeping · press when the needle is centred
minigame.MG-12.hint.pad: Drag: across = gimbal, up = throttle · arrow keys
minigame.MG-12.hint.one: Press anywhere to lock or unlock the throttle
minigame.MG-12.aria.label: Engine-out rebalance. Drag on the pad, or use left and right arrows for gimbal and up and down arrows for throttle, to keep the net torque near zero.
minigame.MG-12.aria.label_one: Engine-out rebalance, one button. The throttle sweeps by itself; press Space or the screen to lock it when the torque needle is centred, press again to unlock.
minigame.MG-12.aria.value: Net torque {torque} kilonewton metres, {state}. Throttle {throttle} percent, gimbal {gimbal} degrees.

minigame.MG-10.status.right: HALF IS {m} m TO THE RIGHT · STEER RIGHT
minigame.MG-10.scene.title: Recovery zone · your half has the gold parafoil
minigame.MG-10.hint.drag: Touch where the boat should go · ← → keys
minigame.MG-10.hint.hold: Hold anywhere to steer to your half, let go to drift
minigame.MG-10.hint.toggle: Tap anywhere to start or stop steering to your half
minigame.MG-10.aria.label: Fairing catch. Touch the scene where your boat should go, or hold the left and right arrow keys, to keep the net under your fairing half.
minigame.MG-10.aria.label_one: Fairing catch, one button. Hold Space or the screen to steer the boat to your half; release to drift.
